SELECT 
  s.store_id,
  s.store_name,
  s.region,
  s.format,
  ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount) - COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0), 2) as net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
WHERE s.store_id < 900  -- Exclude web shop (900) and training store (999)
  AND f.product_key NOT IN (SELECT product_key FROM dim_product WHERE category = 'ZZ Test')
GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name, s.region, s.format
ORDER BY net_sales DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT 
  store_id,
  SUM(net_sales) as total_from_control
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
WHERE store_id < 900
GROUP BY store_id
ORDER BY total_from_control DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH sales_by_store AS (
  SELECT 
    f.store_key,
    SUM(f.net_amount) as total_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  WHERE s.store_id < 900  -- Exclude web shop and training store
    AND f.product_key IN (SELECT product_key FROM dim_product WHERE category <> 'ZZ Test' AND is_current = TRUE)
  GROUP BY f.store_key
),
returns_by_store AS (
  SELECT 
    r.store_key,
    SUM(r.refund_net) as total_returns
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_store s ON r.store_key = s.store_key
  WHERE s.store_id < 900
    AND r.product_key IN (SELECT product_key FROM dim_product WHERE category <> 'ZZ Test' AND is_current = TRUE)
  GROUP BY r.store_key
)
SELECT 
  s.store_id,
  s.store_name,
  s.region,
  s.format,
  ROUND(COALESCE(sales.total_sales, 0) - COALESCE(returns.total_returns, 0), 2) as net_sales
FROM dim_store s
LEFT JOIN sales_by_store sales ON s.store_key = sales.store_key
LEFT JOIN returns_by_store returns ON s.store_key = returns.store_key
WHERE s.is_current = TRUE
  AND s.store_id < 900
ORDER BY net_sales DESC
LIMIT 10

  FROM fact_sales_line f

    r.store_key,
    SUM(r.refund_net) as total_returns
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_store s ON r.store_key = s.store_key
  WHERE s.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY r.store_key
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(sales.total_sales, 0) - COALESCE(returns.total_returns, 0)), 2) as net_sales_total
FROM dim_store s
LEFT JOIN sales_by_store sales ON s.store_key = sales.store_key
LEFT JOIN returns_by_store returns ON s.store_key = returns.store_key
WHERE s.is_current = TRUE
  AND s.store_id < 900

SELECT 
  ROUND(SUM(net_amount), 2) as total_sales
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE store_key IN (SELECT store_key FROM dim_store WHERE is_current = TRUE AND store_id < 900)

SELECT 
  ROUND(SUM(refund_net), 2) as total_returns
FROM fact_return_line
WHERE store_key IN (SELECT store_key FROM dim_store WHERE is_current = TRUE AND store_id < 900)

WITH fact_sales_with_store AS (
  SELECT 
    f.store_key,
    f.net_amount
  FROM fact_sales_line f
),
fact_returns_with_store AS (
  SELECT 
    r.store_key,
    r.refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r
)
SELECT 
  s.store_id,
  s.store_name,
  ROUND(
    COALESCE((SELECT SUM(f.net_amount) FROM fact_sales_with_store f WHERE f.store_key = s.store_key), 0)
    - 
    COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r.refund_net) FROM fact_returns_with_store r WHERE r.store_key = s.store_key), 0),
    2
  ) as net_sales
FROM dim_store s
WHERE s.is_current = TRUE
  AND s.store_id < 900
ORDER BY net_sales DESC
LIMIT 10
